posts.title: RRB NTPC 2026 CBT-2 Examination Schedule Released - Check Official Notice
posts.summary: The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has officially released the examination schedule for the RRB NTPC 2026 CBT-2 stage. Candidates are advised to check the official notice to verify their exam dates and instructions.
posts.content:
### RRB NTPC 2026 CBT-2 Exam Schedule Update

The Railway Recruitment Board has officially announced the schedule for the Computer Based Test 2 (CBT-2) for the NTPC recruitment cycle. Candidates who have qualified for the second stage are requested to visit the official regional RRB websites to download the detailed schedule.

#### How to Check the Exam Schedule:
1. Visit the official website of your respective RRB region.
2. Look for the link titled 'CBT-2 Exam Schedule' under the latest notifications section.
3. Download the PDF notice to check your specific exam date and shift timings.
4. Keep your registration details ready for future reference.

#### Important Instructions for Candidates:
- Ensure you carry a printed copy of your admit card once released.
- Follow all COVID-19 and examination center guidelines strictly.
- Regularly check the official website for any further updates regarding the exam center city intimation.
important_points: RRB NTPC 2026 CBT-2 exam schedule has been officially released.
Candidates should check their respective regional RRB websites for the detailed notice.
The schedule contains information regarding exam dates and shift timings.

posts.content:

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has officially published the results for the Computer Based Test 2 (CBT 2) conducted under CEN 06/2025. Candidates who appeared for the examination can now verify their results via the official roll number-wise list.

### How to Check Your Result
1. Download the official PDF provided by the RRB.
2. Open the document using a PDF reader.
3. Use the search function (Ctrl+F) to enter your Roll Number.
4. If your roll number is highlighted, you have qualified for the next stage of the recruitment process.

### Next Steps
Qualified candidates are advised to keep a close watch on the official regional RRB websites for further instructions regarding document verification and medical examinations.

posts.title: RRB Technician CEN 02/2024 Answer Key Released - Check Response Sheet & Raise Objections
posts.summary: Railway Recruitment Boards has released the tentative answer key and question paper response sheet for the Technician Grade-1 and Grade-3 CBT exam. Candidates can access their response sheets via the official RRB portal and submit objections if necessary.
posts.content:
### RRB Technician (CEN 02/2024) Answer Key Released

The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) has officially released the tentative answer key and candidate response sheets for the Technician Grade-1 and Grade-3 Computer Based Test (CBT). Candidates who appeared for the examination can now view their responses and evaluate their performance.

#### How to Check Answer Key:
1. Visit the official RRB website at [rrbcdg.gov.in](https://rrbcdg.gov.in) or the direct digital portal.
2. Log in using your registration credentials.
3. Navigate to the 'Candidate Response' or 'Answer Key' section.
4. Download your response sheet for future reference.

#### Objection Process:
If a candidate finds any discrepancy in the provided answer key, they can raise an objection through the official portal. Please note that a fee of ₹50 per question is applicable. This fee is refundable if the objection is found to be valid.
important_points: RRB Technician Grade-1 & Grade-3 CBT answer key is now live.
Candidates can check their response sheets on the official RRB portal.
Objection fee is set at ₹50 per question.
The objection fee is refundable if the challenge is accepted as valid.
